capture.final_message:
Use two independent facts.

- Unfold `ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound`. Its construction includes a positive successor term, so positivity should follow directly from its defining formula or an existing positivity lemma.

- For the binomial statement, work modulo \(p\). Since \(p\) is prime, the Frobenius identity gives
  \[
  (1+X)^{p^n}=1+X^{p^n}\quad\text{in }\mathbf F_p[X].
  \]
  Comparing the coefficient of \(X^k\) shows that \(\binom{p^n}{k}\equiv0\pmod p\) unless \(k=0\) or \(k=p^n\). At those two indices the coefficient is \(1\), hence is not divisible by \(p\). This also handles \(k>p^n\), because the binomial coefficient is then \(0\).

A compact Lean proof should therefore locate the existing `degBound` positivity result and the library theorem expressing prime divisibility of the interior binomial coefficients of a prime power, using the Frobenius/coefficient argument only if that theorem is not already packaged.
